Included in the Crisp Plus plan Build your perfect AI Agent in 4 steps Step 1Train your AI Teach Crisp about your product or business, using the public and private resources you already have. We automatically browse your website for you, but you can also import PDFs and write Knowledge Base articles. 2Create a Workflow Create an AI Agent workflow, using our no-code AI Agent builder or browse through our library of templates to kickstart your new support experience. 3Test & Deploy Workflow Deploy your AI Agent workflow, choosing which messaging channel you want it to trigger from: Web chat widget, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, and even email. 4Validate & Measure See the messages that your users exchanged with your AI Agent. Refine your AI Agent if an answer was invalid. Quickly iterate to automate most of your customer support.
